title: Introducing Contract Intelligence
format_note: Abstract motion-graphic announcement: document metaphors on alternating dark and light grounds, real product UI shown only in the last ten seconds, no voiceover.
one_thing: Contract review becomes automatic approval: documents stream through an Approve line, Harvey's intelligence orbits them, and the product screen proves it with 'Sign faster. Sign smarter.'

transcript.voice_style: No voice. Meaning is carried by on-screen words, typed in and out, over a string-led music bed.
transcript.script_shape: Metaphor first (documents funnel past an Approve line), then an intelligence sphere with five verbs, then a two-line promise, then the product name.

structure.frame0: Near-black ground with a ring of white dots tilted like an orbit, filling about 70% of frame height; no logo, no text. A motif poster rather than the product.
structure.first_3s: The dotted orbit rotates and collapses to a point; an H badge appears at t=2.0s and the name starts to type beside it. No product UI, no claim yet.

beats.what: Dotted orbit spins down into the Harvey H badge, with the wordmark starting to type in (f0001, f0002).
White documents fall past a thin line with an Approve button; each lands dark with a check, then a funnel of pages builds (f0003-f0006).
Hard cut to a toggle that flips on, dark ground fading to light (strip window-10).
Funnel of black documents on white; a few show small spheres, which converge on one document (f0008, f0009).
One document is orbited by dots while labels read Extracting, Scoring risk, Comparing terms, Drafting redlines (f0010-f0012).
H document becomes a column of H documents that drop through the Approve line and come out signed (f0013-f0015).
Hard cut to dark; a small ring grows into a dotted sphere beside 'Upgrading Intelligence.', then five verbs appear around it (f0016-f0019).
Light ground; 'Sign faster' then 'Sign smarter' on the left, real product screens on the right (f0020, f0021).
H badge fades from light to dark and 'Contract Intelligence' types in; held 5.4 s (f0022-f0025).

hero_moment.what: The toggle flips and the whole frame inverts from dark to light in about 0.4 s, naming the product (strips/window-10-12.584s.jpg).

ending.what: H badge plus 'Contract Intelligence' on near-black, held from 44.6 s to the end; no URL or call to action.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: Long animated scenes (15.0 s, 10.9 s, 9.8 s) joined by six hard cuts, three of them inside one 2 s span at 11.8-13.67 s. Change inside a scene comes from motion, not cuts. No burst.

look.ground: Two grounds, near-black (about #0e0f0b) and off-white (about #fafafa), swapped five times; the toggle frame uses a warm grey (f0007).
look.accent_use: No accent colour in the motion layer; the only colour is inside the product UI at t=40-44 (blue 'Needs your judgment', green 'Ready for approval').
look.type: Serif wordmark and caption in a book serif; headline 'Sign faster' in a large italic serif, black on off-white; tiny sans labels with a round white dot beside them.
look.depth: Flat, with soft reflections of documents below the Approve line (f0004, f0005) and a UI card with a faint shadow; the dotted sphere gives the only 3D.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Panel sits in the right half and bleeds off the right edge; it slides in about t=40.2 s and swaps to a second screen by t=42 s. No zoom into it.
product_ui.notes: Real screens appear only at 40.2-44.6 s. Row text such as 'Nova Corp · MSA', 'Ready for approval', 'Needs your judgment' is crisp at 720p (crops/ui-table.png) but about 1.5% of frame height, so it will not read at phone width. Right-hand columns are cut off.

motion.text_entry: Type-on, one letter at a time: 'faster' at 40.17-40.65 s, 'Contract Intelligence' at 44.6-45.1 s. Small labels scramble before settling ('vfweighing risks' to 'reweighing risks', 'hsafting amendments' to 'drafting amendments').
motion.ui_motion: Documents fall in a column at constant spacing, cross the Approve line and darken with a check, and the funnel builds row by row; UI panels slide in from the right.
motion.camera: Locked-off frame throughout; all movement is on the objects. The sphere rotates continuously.
motion.eases: Strips show a soft ease-out on the type-on and the toggle; the toggle flips in about 0.4 s. Exits are quick (dark to light in under 0.5 s). Not measured beyond that.

transitions.cause: Light scene ends on a signed document; dark scene opens on a small ring.
Toggle flips and the ground inverts from dark to light.
The toggle switch itself changes state.
Documents keep falling past the fixed Approve line across scenes.
Orbit shrinks into the H badge; H document becomes the column of H pages.

good.observation: One visual idea carries the film: documents stream past an Approve line, and the same line returns at 3 s, 24 s and 26 s, so the claim 'review then approve' is shown, not said.
Dark and light grounds alternate five times, giving each chapter a different mood with no extra graphics.
The dotted orbit is a single recurring motif: frame 0, around the document at 18 s and as the 28-39 s sphere, so the film reads as one object.
The toggle flip names the product and changes the ground in one 0.4 s gesture.
Headline is two words in a big italic serif at 11% of frame height, with the second word swapped (faster to smarter); it is readable instantly.
The only UI shown has believable rows (named contracts, risk counts, 92% aligned), so the promise is backed by specifics.
End card holds the name 5.4 s with nothing else, giving the film a calm landing.

weak.observation: The product is not on screen until 40.2 s, 80% through the film, and the screens fill only 9% of runtime; a viewer who leaves at 30 s has seen metaphor only.
Verb labels around the sphere are about 10-12 px tall in the 720p frame and scramble on entry ('hsafting amendments', 'vfweighing risks'), so they read as typos at a glance.
UI panel is cropped by the right edge; the columns that carry the proof (status, notes) are cut, and the rows are about 1.5% of frame height.
Loudness is -19.1 LUFS integrated with a 16.8 LU range, well below a social master target.
Ten seconds of dark documents (2.4-11.8 s) show no label or claim, so what the film is about is unclear until the toggle at 12.6 s.

rule_candidates.rule: Put the product screen in the first half; here real UI first appears at 40.2 s (80%) and fills 9% of runtime, so the abstract opening needs a screen glimpse by 12 s.
Hold a shot 10-15 s when one object keeps changing (documents, orbit, labels); this film runs 15.0 s, median shot 5.36 s, 7.2 cuts a minute and still keeps attention.
Switch between a dark and a light ground at each chapter, at a hard cut or a 0.4 s fade-through; five switches in 50 s.
Keep a single recurring motif (a dotted orbit here) in frame 0, the middle and the end so a metaphor film reads as one idea.
Type the headline's second word in after the first has held 0.4-0.5 s, then swap that word for the pair line; both lines are about 11% of frame height.
Never label with scrambled glyphs or text under 2.6% of frame height; here labels about 10-12 px (1.5%) with scrambled starts read as typos.
Close on a wordmark held at least 5 s with nothing added; here 44.6-49.96 s.
A quiet orchestral bed at -19.1 LUFS misses the -14 LUFS social target by 5.1 LU; normalise even when the music is soft and string-led.
